in_marathi.name: Ashmita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashmita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashmita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'asmita', meaning 'self-aware'. This name is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Ashmita represents the inner wisdom and intelligence that is present in all individuals.
